3.text: Instead of saying “We’ve helped many families in the area,” try: “Last week, we helped Mrs.
Johnson from Maple Street fix her leaky faucet, saving her time and money.
” Personal anecdotes resonate far more powerfully than generic claims.
Consider including a photo of the project you completed, or a short video testimonial.

6.text: Don't just tell people what you’re doing.
Tell them what they can do right now.
Use your email to show local proof.

7.text: Show what you’ve done for someone nearby.
A local plumber could share a photo of a recently completed repair with a brief description of the problem and the solution.
